subject: LINE clause
notes: kb/Work PB1001. A NEXT PAGE phrase on any LINE clause but the group's first is COBOL2199; a multiple LINE clause's later operands are SR10a's (MultipleLineOperands) and are not reported twice. The binder sets the run-time flag only on the group's first report line (RepeatedLine), so a replayed occurrence places as the phrase-less form.
